events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. It's 49 years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and legacy live on. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us 56 years ago today. His guitar mastery continues to inspire. Which Hendrix track is your go-to?

events.title: Abbey Road Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to that incredible medley, it's a masterpiece. What's your highlight from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the influential frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and a voice that never quits. What's your favourite Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking stages and headlines. What's your favourite Oasis or Liam solo track?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his second studio album, 'Imagine', in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. An album that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and what's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. An incredibly diverse and groundbreaking record. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
